setting: After months of long-distance calls, a couple reunites at a station and struggles to put the moment into words.
lyrics:
Said I love you, said I love you
Said I love you, said I love you

Face to face
I'm looking at you in a secret place
Undress the words so we say nothing fake
It's so much better when our words are naked
We don't need space
I wanna hold you tight again
For us to feel each others hearts at the “right place”
I guess this is why God made us like this

Songs sound amazing with you
Views lose their beauty without you
It feels like I don't exist without you baby
Without you baby
Without you baby

I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking

Love you

Touch my hair
Your lips stroke my lips
When we share these beautiful moments
How I dare myself to love you
I'm reminiscing time after time
Missing your caress
It makes me feel high again
Naturally addicted to your effects
It's like a “love drug”
I guess this is why God made your hands like this

Everytime I'm clothed in your warmth
I can see many aspects of you in me
It feels like I'm so empty without you baby
Without you baby
Without you baby

I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”

I wish I could rewind this song beyond my memories
Over and over......
Ooh...

I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking
My body's talking to you

lyricConnections.explanationJa: face to face は『直接会って』。画面越しだった二人がようやく会えた場面に使う。
time after time は『何度も繰り返し』。ここでは再会の瞬間を何度も想像したことを表す。
hold you tight は『ぎゅっと抱きしめる』。言葉にならない親しさを動作で伝える表現。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: It's strange seeing you face to face after all those video calls.
sentences.displayHtml: It's strange seeing you face to face after all those video calls.

conversation.japanese: いた。あれだけビデオ通話してたのに、こうして直接会うと不思議な感じだね。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You've barely said anything since I got off the train.
sentences.displayHtml: You've barely said anything since I got off the train.

conversation.japanese: それ、悪い意味で？ 私が電車を降りてから、ほとんど何も話してないよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: No, I've imagined this time after time.
sentences.displayHtml: No, I've imagined this time after time.

sentences.text: Now you're actually here, and my mind's gone blank.
sentences.displayHtml: Now you're actually here, and my mind's gone blank.

conversation.japanese: 違うよ。この瞬間を何度も想像したんだ。なのに本当に君が来たら、頭が真っ白になっちゃって。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I had a whole speech ready, but now I just want to get closer.
sentences.displayHtml: I had a whole speech ready, but now I just want to get closer.

conversation.japanese: 私も。話すことをいっぱい考えてたのに、今はただそばに行きたい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Let me hold you tight before we go anywhere.
sentences.displayHtml: Let me hold you tight before we go anywhere.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、おいで。どこかへ行く前に、ぎゅっと抱きしめさせて。

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.japanese: うん、これ。ずっとこうしたかった。
